svg.title: Aftermath: Manga screentone, evidence tents
svg.desc: Aftermath (1D): a room after the Toxin State, drawn in manga screentone: grey dot fields for the floor and walls, a wide empty frame. Numbered evidence tents stand beside each trace (a torn strap, a dented locker, a long scrape, a dropped torch, a hardened black scab flake). Along the bottom a strip of empty numbered slots waits for the player to put the traces in the order the body made them; three are placed.
